query: Provide power/sample-size calculations for both static and reduced-form dynamic specifications: minimum detectable dynamic pricing effect under assumed instrument strength and noise levels.

response.query: Provide power/sample-size calculations for both static and reduced-form dynamic specifications: minimum detectable dynamic pricing effect under assumed instrument strength and noise levels.
response.answer: Power/sample-size calculations for dynamic pricing effects require assumptions on instrument strength and noise levels; typically, simulations or software tools are used for precise estimates. Static and reduced-form dynamic specifications differ in complexity and assumptions. Use established econometric methods for accurate results.
